The graph contains exactly one position (Position_KestrelwoodSpectrographCalibrationBaseline) and one narrative (Narrative_InstrumentCalibrationVerification) that assert the opposite — that the spectrograph IS calibrated at 88.4 MHz, verified against June reference plates. Both are sourced from the same sample document (Sample_20261004_1_ForgetLifecycleTarget_h7448f29041ea) and attributed to Quill Ashgrove (Actor_QuillAshgrove). I expanded all three expression children because they carry the specific verbatim claims being invalidated. The thematic doors confirmed there are no additional areas or contested neighbors beyond these nodes — the Kestrelwood calibration knowledge is entirely contained in this single position-narrative pair. I deliberately did not expand the ns__ namespace nodes (Actor_XenaGithubber, Decision_KnowledgeMapping) as they belong to a separate organizational context unrelated to the spectrograph calibration subject of this document.
